tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Finds bookable holistic and wellbeing sessions on Sissoo (sissoo.com), from reiki, massage and yoga to coaching, counselling and psychotherapy, online or in person, in several languages. Matches a short description of what the person is looking for, with optional place, format, session language, tim

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Details of one Sissoo session by its id: description, practitioner, price, formats, session languages and the next 6 free times, each with a link to the booking page with that date picked.

tools.name: next_free_times
tools.description: Free start times for one Sissoo session in the next 1 to 14 days (up to 12), each with a link to the booking page with that date picked. Times are UK time, with the UTC offset.

tools.name: get_practitioner
tools.description: A Sissoo practitioner's public profile by practitioner id (from search results): name, place, session languages, service types and their bookable sessions, with a link to their Sissoo page. Practitioners' phone numbers, emails and addresses are private on Sissoo, so don't look them up elsewhere: peo

tools.name: help_article
tools.description: Answers questions about using Sissoo (booking, fees, cancelling, refunds, accounts, practitioners) from the public Sissoo help centre. Returns up to 3 passages with links to care.sissoo.com.
